documented_scenarios.description: The manifest JSON is not a valid IntakeManifest.
documented_scenarios.reason: Fails at manifest load before normalization runs.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Fix the manifest against the template; remove guidance keys.

documented_scenarios.reason: Fails at manifest load; bar_interval is required.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Declare bar_interval to match the export.

documented_scenarios.description: A local timestamp is ambiguous at a daylight-saving fall-back.
documented_scenarios.reason: Requires an IANA daylight-saving zone; IANA tz data is environment-limited.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Re-declare event_timezone as UTC or an explicit offset if the export supports it.

documented_scenarios.description: A local timestamp falls in a daylight-saving spring-forward gap.
documented_scenarios.reason: Requires an IANA daylight-saving zone; IANA tz data is environment-limited.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Re-declare event_timezone as UTC or an explicit offset if the export supports it.

documented_scenarios.description: artifact_relative_path is absolute or escapes the intake root.
documented_scenarios.reason: The model rejects absolute paths at load; no absolute path enters identity.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Use a relative path such as raw/your-export.csv.

documented_scenarios.description: An attempt to associate a bundle with a real case during Batch 04.
documented_scenarios.reason: Batch 04 preflight performs no case association; there is no such code path.
documented_scenarios.remediation: Do not attempt association in Batch 04; it is future authorized work only.

executed_scenarios.description: No file at the declared path.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Place the exact raw file, or fix artifact_relative_path.

executed_scenarios.description: Declared byte length does not match the bytes.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Recompute artifact_byte_length for the exact file.

executed_scenarios.description: Declared SHA-256 does not match the bytes.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Recompute artifact_sha256 for the exact file.

executed_scenarios.description: Profile declares an unsupported encoding.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Set encoding to a supported value (utf-8, utf-8-sig, ascii, latin-1).

executed_scenarios.description: Manifest declares a non-CSV format.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Provide a CSV export and set artifact_format to CSV.

executed_scenarios.description: event_timezone cannot be resolved.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Use UTC or an explicit offset like -05:00.

executed_scenarios.description: A session-based (daily) interval is declared.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Provide a supported fixed-interval export and declare it.

executed_scenarios.description: timestamp_semantics is UNKNOWN.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Set timestamp_semantics to START or END per the provider convention.

executed_scenarios.description: price_adjustment_semantics is UNKNOWN.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Declare the price/volume/corporate-action semantics from provider docs.

executed_scenarios.description: Adjusted price with raw corporate-action handling.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Make price adjustment and corporate_action_handling consistent.

executed_scenarios.description: data_time_basis is CURRENT.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Provide a historical export and declare HISTORICAL.

executed_scenarios.description: Synthetic fixture declared as historical evidence.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Set intended_use to INFRASTRUCTURE_FIXTURE for synthetic data.

executed_scenarios.description: A row symbol disagrees with the manifest.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Correct provider_symbol or the symbol_column mapping.

executed_scenarios.description: A row venue disagrees with the manifest.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Correct market_or_venue or the venue_column mapping.

executed_scenarios.description: A price is not a valid decimal.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Correct decimal_separator/thousands_separator_policy.

executed_scenarios.description: A price is NaN.
executed_scenarios.remediation: If NaN means null, map via null_tokens; otherwise obtain clean data.

executed_scenarios.description: A required OHLC value is missing.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Fix the OHLC mapping if a real value was misread as null.

executed_scenarios.description: A bar carries negative volume.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Fix the volume_column mapping if a wrong column was mapped.

executed_scenarios.description: A bar carries a negative trade count.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Fix the trade_count_column mapping if a wrong column was mapped.

executed_scenarios.description: A bar high is below open/close (impossible OHLC).
executed_scenarios.remediation: Fix the OHLC mapping if high/low were transposed.

executed_scenarios.description: A bar falls outside declared coverage.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Widen expected_start_time/expected_end_time to the true coverage.

executed_scenarios.description: Two identical rows under COLLAPSE_IDENTICAL_REJECT_CONFLICTING.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Identical duplicates are collapsed (quarantine); choose the intended duplicate_policy.

executed_scenarios.description: Two identical rows under REJECT_ALL_DUPLICATES.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Under REJECT_ALL_DUPLICATES all duplicates reject; choose the intended policy.

executed_scenarios.description: Two rows share a timestamp but disagree on values.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Obtain a clean export without conflicting duplicates.

executed_scenarios.description: A later bar starts before the previous bar's end.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Correct bar_interval/timestamp_semantics if mis-declared.

executed_scenarios.description: Unsorted rows under REQUIRE_PRESORTED.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Set sort_expectation to STABLE_SORT_BY_EVENT_START if unordered input is acceptable.

executed_scenarios.description: Continuity required but consecutive bars leave a gap.
executed_scenarios.remediation: Set session_coverage_policy to ALLOW_GAPS if gaps are legitimate.

note: Deterministic invalid scenarios. Executed scenarios run the synthetic bundle through the real preflight workflow; documented scenarios describe load-time or environment-limited barriers. No unsafe input is auto-repaired.
